subject: Key archive logbook & rotation timeline — auditor intake
messages:
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@lilybank.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, lilybank-security@lilybank.com
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: archival key inventory + rotation timeline for SIG intake

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for helping with LilyBank's SIG intake. Our audit team needs a concise package describing your historical key archival state and rotation timelines for the past 18 months. At a minimum we need:

- A machine-readable index of active and archived key identifiers (key IDs) and their storage buckets/keystores to validate retention windows.
- Rotation timeline for each tenant-affecting KEK/DEK pair (UTC timestamps + operator id).
- Operator access list for the rotation events (who initiated / approved).

Can you provide an export or a low-friction CSV/TSV for the key index plus a human-readable PDF with the rotation timeline? If possible, include sample KVCACHE traces for one tenancy to demonstrate the cache eviction pattern — just a brief snippet is fine.

Ideal delivery: within five business days. If there's a security or gating step (NDA/DocuSign) we should complete before you ship artefacts, flag it and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Audrey Chen
Security Auditor — LilyBank
Auditors@lilybank.com

---
Note: this request is scoped to cryptographic archival/rotation items only; we will request telemetry and network logs separately.
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@lilybank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival key inventory + rotation timeline for SIG intake

Audrey —

Appreciate the clear scope. We can deliver a compact package that includes:

- key-archive-logbook.csv (machine-readable index: key_id, type, tenant_id, storage_path, created_at, archived_at, retention_policy)
- kms-rotation-timeline.pdf (human-readable timeline with UTC timestamps and operator IDs)
- operator-acl.xlsx (cross-reference of operator usernames, roles, and last authn timestamp)

We will redact any tenant PII and provide a sample KVCACHE snippet for one tenant (anonymized) inline in the PDF.

Delivery plan:
1) I'll attach an initial CSV and timeline PDF in this thread for intake review (attached).
2) Markus will follow up with the rotation provenance notes and the operator ACL export if you need expanded ACLs.
3) If LilyBank requires a signed evidence receipt or an intake DocuSign, point us to the DocuSign link and Ben will route.

If the auditor scope requires SOC2 appendix references (control IDs) or CAIQ mappings, tell us and we'll add a short mapping table.

Deliverables attached: key-archive-logbook.csv; kms-rotation-timeline.pdf

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
(650) 555-0198

Attachments: key-archive-logbook.csv (CSV, 84KB), kms-rotation-timeline.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@lilybank.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival key inventory + rotation timeline for SIG intake

Hi Audrey —

Adding a few technical clarifications to the deliverables Lauren shared:

- The CSV uses stable key_id values (SHA256-derived stable handles) — we do not export raw key material. The storage_path column references our internal keystore URIs (redwood-km://...).
- Rotation timeline rows include: key_id, rotation_event_id, rotated_from (key_id), rotated_to (key_id), executed_at_utc, initiated_by (operator_username), approval_ticket (if present).
- operator-acl.xlsx (attached in this follow-up) contains per-operator last_authn, role, and high-level justification tag (e.g., oncall, infra-runbook). We will anonymize operator email addresses on request.

Important: for signed attestations we can provide a redacted sample of the KVCACHE trace for a non-production tenant. The trace contains tokenized references only (no sensitive plaintext).

If LilyBank wants event-level cryptographic proofs (signed audit events), we can produce a time-limited export and a verification instruction set; that is more controlled and we usually execute it under an NDA addendum.

Markus Klein
Principal, Infastructure Security
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachments: operator-acl.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@lilybank.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, lilybank-security@lilybank.com
Date: Thu, 31 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: archival key inventory + rotation timeline for SIG intake

Lauren / Markus —

Thanks — we received the CSV, timeline pdf, and the operator ACL spreadsheet. Quick acknowledgements and next asks:

- The CSV format is perfect; we'll use it to reconcile retention windows.
- The rotation timeline has the fields we need. Please include the timezone (UTC) header in the PDF for clarity (we saw UTC but want it explicit on page 1).
- For operator-acl.xlsx: we accept anonymized emails but need operator usernames + last_authn timestamps (present in current sheet).

Two small follow-ups:
1) Can you produce a one-page control mapping that states which SOC 2 control(s) this archive+rotation package evidences (for our SIG intake column set)? A short table is fine.
2) Do you require any formal intake (DocuSign) prior to us pulling the artifacts into our audit repository? If so, please send the link.

If those are fine, we'll mark the artifact intake as complete on our side and proceed with the SIG assessment.

Audrey Chen
Security Auditor — LilyBank
